_notes: Keys with cur=null (no Russian line; the UI fell back to English) were translated and are marked why='missing'; apply-patch.mjs creates them from the English key (dry run: 0 refused).
Plural families: _few/_many forms added for every family that was missing or whose existing forms lacked the noun (e.g. ws.itemsInReview, applicants.requested, v23.work.submissionsNeed).
Standard admission letter = «стандартное приглашение на обучение» (short label «приглашение на обучение»), matching the marketing/common patch.
Agency voice: вы-form, imperative; University voice: formal and analytical (Insights questions rewritten away from «где мы их теряем»).
agency:v29.guide.verifyRequired / common:task.submissionAgency: 'authorised' managed submission rendered as «по поручению» (agency submits on the student's authority).
Hangyul HQ rendered as «Штаб Hangyul»; Hangyul Operations as «Операционная команда Hangyul» (same as common:role).
